title: Protocol Drift Atlas Perturbation Registry
description: Schema for the versioned v0.1 registry of declared, unvalidated protocol-sensitivity transformations. The registry freezes the four perturbations used in v0.1 and prevents scope drift before the first tagged release.

perturbations.description: Exactly four perturbations are allowed in v0.1. Any addition requires a version bump and a documented scope change.

perturbation_id.description: Stable identifier. Must start with P1, P2, P3 or P4, followed by a short uppercase label.

family.description: Human-readable family name for the transformation.

perturbation_level.description: Level at which the transformation operates. protocol = rubric or ordering. prompt = label wording. framing = evaluator role or framing.

status.description: In v0.1 every perturbation must be declared_unvalidated. Human validation is a funded extension.

description.description: Neutral description of what is changed.

expected_invariance_claim.description: The invariance claim the transformation is intended to preserve. This is a declared assumption, not a validated fact.

why_this_may_fail.description: Known mechanisms by which the invariance claim may be false. This field is required so that no perturbation can be registered without an explicit failure hypothesis.

eligible_for_primary_claims.description: In v0.1 this must be false for every perturbation. No v0.1 transformation may support a primary empirical claim.

prompt_template_id.description: Filename of the Jinja2 template associated with this perturbation, located in src/protocol_drift_atlas/prompts/.

positive_example.description: An example that illustrates the intended transformation.

negative_example.description: An example that looks similar but must not be classified as this perturbation.
